description: Decode ILOSTAT's code vocabulary: reference areas (ISO3 countries and X-coded aggregates, with World Bank income group and ILO region), the groups that area_group accepts (X01 for every country, ILO regions and subregions, World Bank income groups; exact-code lookups list their member countries), databases, subjects, sex codes, breakdown codes for classif1/classif2 with their classification types, per-country data sources, observation status flags, note codes, and frequencies. Filter by text or look up exact codes; long topics page with a cursor. These are ILOSTAT-wide vocabularies; ilostat_describe_indicator lists the sex and breakdown codes one dataset actually uses.

classification_type.description: Topic classifications only: keep codes of this classification type, the code prefix (AGE, ECO, EDU, …).

codes.description: Exact codes to look up (up to 100; case-insensitive, and ILO_GEO_ forms accepted for ref_areas and area_groups). Codes the topic lacks are listed in not_found. With topic area_groups, each group found also lists its member countries.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token: the previous page's next_cursor, passed unchanged.

filter.description: Text filter: every word must match a word or word prefix of the code or label (case, accents, and punctuation ignored; labor matches labour). Omit to list the whole topic.

ref_area.description: Topic sources only: list the sources of this reference area (ISO3 or X code; case-insensitive, ILO_GEO_ forms accepted).

topic.description: Vocabulary to list: ref_areas, area_groups (the X codes area_group accepts), databases, subjects, sexes, classifications (classif1/classif2 codes), classification_types, sources, obs_status, notes, or frequencies.

name: ilostat_list_reference

cap.description: The limit applied to this page.

catalog_as_of.description: ISO timestamp the in-memory catalog was last confirmed current.

entries.description: This page of decoded codes, ordered by code — except sexes, which keep the ILOSTAT dictionary's order (SEX_T first), and frequencies, listed annual, quarterly, monthly.

items.description: One decoded code; fields beyond code and label depend on the topic.

classification_type.description: classifications: the code prefix naming its classification type (AGE, ECO, …).

code.description: The code other ILOSTAT tools take.

data_end.description: ref_areas: last year with data, any frequency.

data_start.description: ref_areas: first year with data, any frequency.

dataset_count.description: Datasets using the code: per database, subject, or frequency; for ref_areas, datasets with data for the area summed over frequencies.

frequencies.description: ref_areas: frequencies with data for the area (A annual, Q quarterly, M monthly).

group_types.description: area_groups: which grouping levels use the code (world is X01, every country); one code can serve several.

ilo_region.description: ref_areas: ILO region, as its X code.

ilo_subregion_broad.description: ref_areas: broad ILO subregion, as its X code.

ilo_subregion_detailed.description: ref_areas: detailed ILO subregion, as its X code.

income_group.description: ref_areas: World Bank income group, as its X code.

kind.description: ref_areas: country, or an X-coded aggregate (World, region, income group).

members.description: area_groups looked up by exact codes only: the member countries, by code. A listing without codes gives member_count alone.

code.description: ISO3 code of the member country.

ref_area.description: sources: the reference area the source belongs to.

slot.description: classifications: the query parameter slot the code is used in.

source_type.description: sources: the label prefix before " - " (LFS, PC, ADM, ILO, OE, …).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_code`: ref_area is not an ILOSTAT reference area. `param_not_for_topic`: ref_area with a topic other than sources, or classification_type with a topic other than classifications. `invalid_cursor`: cursor does not decode. `catalog_unavailable`: No catalog snapshot has loaded and the load failed, or the first load has not finished within 30 s. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to get the next page; absent on the last page.

not_found.description: Requested codes the topic does not contain; present only when codes missed.

notice.description: Why a filter with no searchable word was not applied, why nothing matched, that the cursor starts past the last entry, and how to reach the remaining pages — whichever apply, joined.

total.description: Entries matching the filters, across all pages.

truncated.description: True when more entries remain beyond this page.

title: List ILOSTAT reference codes
